items.question: Do I need Meta's official API to get started?
items.answer: No. You can start today with the number you already use, with no approval wait. When it makes sense for your clinic, you can move to WhatsApp's official API.

items.question: Is my data and my patients' data safe?
items.answer: Yes. Your patients' messages and personal data are encrypted, and every account's data is isolated from other Sales Flow customers.

items.question: Can I use the number I already use today?
items.answer: Yes. You don't need to switch numbers or migrate your contact base to start using Sales Flow.

items.question: Do I need to be good with tech?
items.answer: No. Our team sets everything up with you, and after that the dashboard is easy for your front desk and the rest of the team to use, no developer needed.
